author: Axiom II
title: Run shared logs combiner v0_3 (sample JSONL)
abstract: Runs a safe combiner over shared progressor/raw_eval_logs and emits a JSONL sample (≤200 records). Handles json/jsonl/txt/log and .gz, annotates source, and prints a summary.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared/agency_lab/data/progressor/raw_eval_logs')
from logs_to_jsonl_v0_3 import run

if __name__ == "__main__":
    summary = run(max_records=200)
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
